method: Seeds 1..N, same twelve-quarter story choices, no sides or borrowing. Each non-cash policy buys one company for 10000 each quarter, sells next quarter, and reserves a hypothetical net sale at the final quote. Real fees, slippage and received dividends included. Public policy uses notice wording direction, published cash/revenue, debt and quote growth relative to disclosed revenue growth; accountsOnly omits notices. Synthetic benchmark, not a promise of player profit.
